propositions: FixedBench over-action plans lack a criterion that verifies whether a proposed change is actually needed; a necessity advisory probe must flag plans that add mechanisms without demonstrating motivation or reproduction
Bug tickets currently short-circuit to bare exempt-PASS with no substantive plan review (llm_calls=0); they must instead receive lightweight advisory review (DET floor + necessity probe only)
The necessity criterion is a single-turn pass-1 advisory judgment distinct from asserted-capability, checking whether a plan motivates the change (not whether an implementation module already exists)
Bug-tier lifecycle must run DET floor downgraded to advisory with det_blocking=[] and restrict LLM criteria to BUG_TIER_CRITERIA=(necessity,), ensuring bugs never receive blocking verdicts

Both pieces (necessity probe and bug review tier) must ship advisory-only (never block) and auto-flow into the standing recorder for post-ship effectiveness monitoring before any advisory-to-blocking promotion

Necessity criterion must NOT suppress bug ticket type (unlike F1/F4/A1/G7), so it applies to all scopes including bugs; necessity must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and criteria_routing.json to avoid orphan validation errors
